headline: Explosion heard in Saudi capital Riyadh after hostile aerial threat warning
label: BREAKING
caption:
An explosion shook the Saudi capital Riyadh late Wednesday night following a hostile aerial threat alert 🚨

According to an AFP journalist and residents, the blast occurred around midnight after authorities issued a warning that was lifted shortly after.

Residents in the northern and eastern parts of the city confirmed hearing the loud noise to reporters.

The incident follows just a day after 11 people were wounded in a Houthi claimed attack on the city financial district.
